title: Horror Night
description:
WELCOME TO HORROR NIGHT!Find your way out from an abandoned mansion by solving puzzles, hiding from a horrifying creature, and working in team, in a new multiplayer, third person, horror experience.

Multiplayer VideogameEscape alongside your friends and don't let the creature catch them! 

Get rewarded by helping your teammates, solving puzzles and working in team.

Revive all survivors by bringing their skulls into the resurrection ritual! 

Play as the Creature

Choose your favorite skin, improve your skills by eating rats, and crouch for better speed to catch all survivors.

Hunt down every single one of them to become winner!

Solve Puzzles to Escape the Mansion

Escape by solving randomized puzzles in the mansion, or simply completing a hidden ritual that will get you out of the mansion. 

[Not all clues will lead to something]. Teamwork is essential!

CustomizationAs a Survivor: Customize your character by choosing from a variety of hairstyles, outfits, accesories, lamps and much more!

As the Monster: Select the scariest skin to hunt all players down! 

ProgressUnlock new items by levelling up! (You can also acquire them on the official Horror Night Store)

New LobbyWaiting for your friends to join a match is no longer tedious ;) You'll be able to explore much more terrifying surroundings while doing so, and even speed up the game by simply pressing the new "force start match" lever. 

Character SelectionPlay as the monster or as a survivor in this Free to Play asymmetric version, by throwing yourself into the Well Of Doom.

Improved InteractionInteracting with objects is now faster and easier. Just by pressing E! ;)

TeleportationEscape from the Ayurok clutches even faster through portals and wardrobes. 

New Horror Night StoreAcquire new items in the official store, by either shopping with real cash (buying gold coins), or simply by completing different missions and objectives within the game, to earn silver coins.
description_short: A new multiplayer, third-person, horror experience: Escape from an appaling environment by solving different puzzles with the help of your friends, and hiding from a hideous monster... or maybe becoming one ;) Unlock new maps, cosmetics and skins with the new Horror Night DLCs
